sections.title: Area clusters
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Area clusters

**Access rights:** Master Data User

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new area cluster.

![](/uploads/c41321f08f6f92e9415c37a8.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new area cluster.

![](/uploads/7717f84d2a55425fd93d6934.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system adds a new data row on the list view. Enter the area cluster information in that row.

![](/uploads/80b82254c76db4ec907db354.png)

**Fields to fill in**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Area cluster name | Name of the area cluster you are creating. |
| 2 | Area cluster code | Code of the area cluster. The system does not allow duplicate codes. |
| 3 | Active | Select this so the area cluster is shown. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/6bd5f39de0839bcdb8b330ae.png)

## Result

The record after it has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/1b08a82bccd8759f99515022.png)

sections.title: Areas
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Areas

**Access rights:** Users with Master Data management rights

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new area.

![](/uploads/85e1c64b40597afa8d866adb.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new area.

![](/uploads/c7cee744b1c898c4f73d07c3.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system adds a new data row on the list view. Enter the area information in that row.

![](/uploads/59564d95cde3581b3a8b292d.png)

**Fields to fill in**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Area name | Enter the name of the area you are creating. |
| 2 | Area code | Code of the area. The system does not allow duplicate codes. |
| 3 | Area level | Enter the level of the area. This field is required and is used to rank areas when calculating driver income. |
| 4 | Area cluster | Select the area cluster this area belongs to. The list of area clusters is configured on the **Area clusters** screen. |
| 5 | Active | Select this so the area is shown. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/e51bd24e483f44feb137c8b0.png)

## Result

The record after it has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/530e4290a2c46470cdcfd87f.png)

sections.title: Locations
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Locations

**Access rights:** Users with Master Data management rights

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new shared location.

![](/uploads/43ad808c335e40783a02c22b.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new shared location.

![](/uploads/0d48ca9206f81ae2bfbc1a36.png)

### Step 2

On the Form View of the shared location screen, enter the details of the location.

![](/uploads/f1f2568b3de0d862b5f49c14.png)

**Fields to fill in**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Location name | Enter the name of the location. |
| 2 | Customer | Select a customer if this location is dedicated to one specific customer. |
| 3 | Location type | Select one of the types: **Port**, **Warehouse**, **ICD**, **Depot** and others. |
| 4 | Address | Enter the address of the location. |
| 5 | Area | Select the area of the address. The list of areas is configured on the **Areas** screen. |
| 6 | Longitude | Enter the longitude of the location. |
| 7 | Latitude | Enter the latitude of the location. |
| 8 | Has a forklift | Indicates whether the location has a forklift. |
| 9 | Contact | Enter the contact person's details. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/d8538f4435b945fce22c7de9.png)

## Result

The record after it has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/8179b86596b77f689a75d6af.png)

sections.title: Routes
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Routes

**Access rights:** Master Data User

Routes can also be created from a **Customer** record, on the **Route list** tab. A route created from a customer record also appears on this screen.

![](/uploads/d2809b684f30540116a7f618.png)

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new route.

![](/uploads/7c0a1c25db68f0b6914ddefc.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new route.

![](/uploads/8f36c5664542a4c82bcf1e72.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system adds a new data row on the list view. Enter the route information in that row.

![](/uploads/e83e6b826e0cd7959c5efe15.png)

**Information to fill in**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Name | An easy-to-remember route name. |
| 2 | Customer | **Required.** Select the customer this route applies to. |
| 3 | From | **Required.** Origin location, taken from the location list. |
| 4 | To | **Required.** Destination location, taken from the location list. |
| 5 | Applies to order | Select the order type the route you are creating applies to. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/a74caae6d54252a934907b3d.png)

## Result

The record after it has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/0b1a1b0c011d5dc9f3111752.png)

sections.title: Route groups
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Master data > Route groups

**Access rights:** Master Data User

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a new route group.

![](/uploads/94c86a51faa62d870ba1b529.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new route group.

![](/uploads/628cc4bc790d341406367992.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system adds a new data row on the list view. Enter the route group information in that row.

![](/uploads/78a4f0608a6cbed16688869e.png)

**Information to fill in**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | From | **Required.** Origin location. Enter the starting location of the route group. |
| 2 | To | **Required.** Destination location. Enter the ending location of the route group. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/3fd301a6b46e02f12a119504.png)

## Result

The record after it has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/c0e3a577fff7509995521f39.png)
